The only changed unit is TestReactorForwardRSTransparent, and only in the x-1 claim comment (ExtractASPathPrependOps -> prependASPathOps); its body still forwards MULTI_EXIT_DISC 100 to an RS client and requires the forwarded body byte-identical, so a stripped or altered MED fails; its x-3 claim (automatic Section 5.1.4 strip never fires toward an RS client, operator del { med; } still removes upstream) is unchanged and states no more than the test checks. TestForwardKeepsMEDForRouteServerClient and med-not-propagated-across-as.ci are unchanged. Verdict unchanged: enforced.
